steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: All living organisms are made of cells.: Cells are the basic building blocks of life. Some organisms are unicellular (made of one cell, like bacteria) and some are multicellular (made of many cells, like humans). | Eukaryotic cells: have a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles. Animals, plants, fungi and protists are eukaryotic. Prokaryotic cells do not have a nucleus. Bacteria are prokaryotic.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Name three structures found in both animal and plant cells. | Name three structures found in plant cells but NOT in animal cells. | Describe two differences between a prokaryotic cell and a eukaryotic cell.
